visualCharacteristics.purpose: Row of grey icon tiles (4/2/1 per row); each tile toggles its own bullet list in place, red chevron indicator
visualCharacteristics.description: No accordion variants exist. 4 grey icon tiles laid out in a 4-column row (2 on tablet, 1 on mobile); each tile is an independently toggling accordion item whose list expands in place under the tile; red chevron indicator.

contentPattern.summary: 4 grey tiles in a 4-col row: red line icon + bold title + red chevron; each tile is a button that expands its own bulleted list in place (accordion-item, max-height transition)
contentPattern.structure: one row per tile: (1) icon image + title text; (2) content (bulleted list)

reuseGuidance: Use for benefit tiles that reveal detail lists. For static tiles use cards-icon; for a stacked FAQ use accordion.
